note: Product specification only. The 20 application entries define intended product scope; browser panels are partial local prototypes and do not prove native DAKOS services or boot-image inclusion.

applications.name: Cockos
boundaries: Visible microphone permission and recording state
Per-application control depends on host audio-session support
Not specified as a professional DAW or hidden recorder

applications.name: Kavun
boundaries: Slices are logical groups and need not duplicate source files
Location and image indexing are user-controllable
Private media metadata requires privacy controls

applications.name: Ka-bon
boundaries: Extracted values require user confirmation
No payment execution or automatic transfers are specified
Financial and family data require explicit access controls

applications.name: Gloverty
boundaries: Rules expose triggers actions scope and enabled state
Privileged or destructive actions require permission and confirmation
Loop prevention and failure behavior are required

applications.name: Po
boundaries: Tracker protection is not anonymity
Site permissions and private browsing state must be understandable
Commands must be distinguishable from URLs and searches

applications.name: Illidia
boundaries: Cloud saves require a compatible provider and conflict handling
Clip capture and sharing require user control
Do Not Disturb must be reversible

applications.name: Unify
boundaries: Pairing must be authenticated and revocable
Sharing permissions are configurable per data type
Lost-device discovery is not guaranteed live location tracking

applications.name: Sestem
boundaries: Reports documented shell and project states only
Does not read native hardware sensors or claim kernel health

applications.name: SetupUP
boundaries: Changes Mora browser-profile preferences only
Not an OS installer, disk partitioner or bootloader configurator

applications.name: Orriganize
boundaries: Entries remain in the current browser profile
No OS scheduler, account sync or shared collaboration

applications.name: Abriganza
boundaries: Reads selected file metadata only
Does not extract archives, execute embedded files or scan for malware

applications.name: Olaab
boundaries: Stores text references and labels only
Does not duplicate source media or provide cloud media sync

applications.name: Concrete Thump
boundaries: Saves rhythm metadata in Mora browser storage
Does not synthesize, record or route audio

applications.name: Seu-Beu
boundaries: Provides a user-operated review checklist only
Does not encrypt, authenticate recipients or enforce OS permissions

applications.name: Love-IL
boundaries: Journal text stays in the current browser profile
No cloud sync, medical advice or secure-vault claim

applications.name: Poi
boundaries: Stores short text entries locally
No system-wide search or global capture shortcut

applications.name: Poi-2
boundaries: Stores text cards in the Mora browser profile
No semantic index, external knowledge source or cloud collaboration

applications.name: Po-2
boundaries: User enters stop names manually
No GPS, live maps, navigation or location tracking

applications.name: GameCharager
boundaries: Game entries and diagnostics remain local
Does not launch executables, install drivers or manage anti-cheat

applications.name: EXEdotEXE
boundaries: Inspects a user-selected file in the browser
Not an antivirus, publisher-signature validator or EXE runtime

prototype.scope: Interactive local prototype. It is not a native DAKOS system application or proof of integration with OS services.

cockos: Microphone recording and local track import/mixdown are available where browser media APIs permit.
Per-application volume settings are stored as preferences and do not change OS audio sessions.
kavun: Local media import, event slices, metadata search and non-destructive preview/export are available.
Image understanding and automatic location recognition are not connected.
ka-bon: Local expense, receipt attachment, subscription and family-member records are available.
Receipt OCR, banking and cloud family sharing are not connected.
gloverty: Rules can be created, enabled and manually run against supported local actions.
OS-wide scheduling, input gestures and global shortcuts are not connected.
po: Tab records, external navigation and pasted-text reading view are available.
The network stack, browser-engine isolation and tracker blocking are not connected.
illidia: Local game catalogue, progress, achievements and user-authorized screen clips are available.
Native executable launch, cloud saves and platform achievement providers are not connected.
unify: Local clipboard APIs and manual JSON export/import for tabs, clips and selected settings are available.
Secure device pairing, live sync, phone notifications and lost-device discovery are not connected.
sestem: Displays Mora shell state and documented subsystem maturity; does not collect native hardware telemetry.
setupup: Stores theme selection and a completion marker in local browser preferences; no OS installation.
orriganize: Stores up to 100 text entries per list in namespaced browser localStorage; no system scheduler.
abriganza: Reads selected archive filename and size only; no archive extraction.
olaab: Stores album and collection labels only; no media duplication or cloud indexing.
concrete-thump: Stores bounded BPM and swing values as local metadata; no audio generation.
seu-beu: Runs a manual sharing checklist; no encryption or identity verification.
love-il: Stores text entries in the current browser profile; no cloud sync.
poi-2: Stores simple text knowledge cards locally; no semantic search.
po-2: Stores a manually ordered list of route stops; no GPS or map service.
gamecharager: Stores game profile names and uses the read-only executable inspector; no process launch.
exedotexe: Reuses local PE/ELF inspection and SHA-256; no executable launch or signature validation.

interfaces.scope: Manual export/import of selected browser tabs, user-selected clips and selected local settings; not live device synchronization.
